name: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather

meta.wiki: Restoring Fiery Flux Supplies via Heavy Leather

summary: After What the Flux?, Master Smith Burninate turns to replenishing the dwindling supply of fiery flux in the Searing Gorge. Burninate wants incendosaur scales, heavy leather, and coal, and will take all you can offer.

sections.title: Fiery Flux Wanted
sections.body: Master Smith Burninate has no time for idle talk. Fiery flux is running low, and Burninate asks for incendosaur scales, heavy leather, and coal: two scales, ten pieces of heavy leather, and coal. Burninate will take all that you can offer.

faq.answer: Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge, who receives the goods in person.
Two incendosaur scales, ten pieces of heavy leather, and some coal.
The step called What the Flux?, which Burninate gave you before this.

faq.q: Why does Burninate want these goods?
faq.answer: Burninate says the supply of fiery flux is dwindling and wants it replenished.
